shame.example: I feel terrible about what I did. I just want to make things right.

anger.example: I can't believe they did that to me. I need them to understand what they caused.

fear.example: I'm scared this will happen again. I don’t feel safe anymore.

sadness.example: It just hurts so much. I miss them every day.

joy.example: I’m so happy right now—I needed this!

guilt.example: I regret saying that. I shouldn't have.

hopelessness.example: Nothing matters anymore. I don't know what to do next.

love.example: I just want to be with them. They make me feel complete.

envy.example: I wish I had what they do. I feel like I’m falling behind.

confusion.example: I don’t understand what’s happening or what I’m supposed to feel.

betrayal.example: They promised me one thing and did another. I can’t trust them anymore.

numbness.example: I don’t feel anything anymore. I just feel empty.

disgust.example: That situation made me feel physically sick. It crossed a line.

pride.example: I worked hard for this and I’m proud of myself.

jealousy.example: Why do they get all the attention? I feel invisible.

regret.example: If I could go back, I’d do it differently. I hate that I messed up.

loneliness.example: I feel like I’m surrounded by people but still so alone.

insecurity.example: I'm not sure I'm good enough. I always doubt myself.

resignation.example: What's the point anymore? Nothing I do changes anything.

resentment.example: I keep doing things for them, but they never notice or care.

gratefulness.example: I’m truly grateful for your kindness. It meant a lot to me.
